name: Dual-Use Goods Procurement via Front Companies
description: Proliferation networks seek controlled or dual-use items through front companies, brokers and intermediaries that disguise the true end user. Financial institutions mainly see this through payments and trade documents, so detection depends on matching customer profile, goods and destination.

sources.text: FATF, Guidance on Counter Proliferation Financing (2018)
FATF, Guidance on Proliferation Financing Risk Assessment and Mitigation (2021)

indicators.name: Customer or counterparty business inconsistent with technical goods traded
indicators.canon: Customer or counterparty business inconsistent with technical goods traded
indicators.desc: Trading or logistics firm with no technical background transacts in items with possible weapons or missile applications.
indicators.ctx: Trading or logistics firm with no technical background transacts in items with possible weapons or missile applications.
indicators.fp: Distributors do handle technical goods outside their main specialty.

indicators.name: End user vague, missing or reluctant to provide details
indicators.canon: End-user information vague, missing or refused
indicators.desc: Customer or buyer is evasive about end use, final destination or end-user certificate, or declines re-export undertakings.
indicators.ctx: Customer or counterparty is evasive about final destination, use or end-user certificate.
indicators.fp: Commercial confidentiality can explain limited detail.

indicators.name: Delivery to freight forwarder, free-trade zone or address unrelated to the buyer
indicators.canon: Delivery to forwarder, mailbox or address unrelated to buyer
indicators.desc: Goods or cards are shipped to freight forwarders, reshippers, mail drops or addresses with no storage or sales operations or link to the buyer.
indicators.ctx: Goods shipped to a forwarder, bonded zone or residential address rather than the end user.

indicators.name: Front company characteristics
indicators.canon: Shell entity with no operating footprint
indicators.desc: Entity has no staff, premises, website or trading history consistent with its stated activity, yet receives significant payments.
indicators.ctx: Recently formed company with minimal premises or staff, shared address or officers with other trading firms, and large-value technical trades.
indicators.fp: Start-ups and virtual offices are legitimate.

indicators.name: Payments from third parties unrelated to the trade
indicators.canon: Payments from or for third parties unrelated to the underlying trade
indicators.desc: Payments are made by parties with no apparent link to the underlying transaction, goods or services.
indicators.ctx: Invoices are settled by firms that are not named in trade documents, often from high-risk or diversion-prone jurisdictions.
indicators.fp: Treasury centres and group payment arrangements are common.

indicators.name: Price or specification not in line with commercial norms
indicators.canon: Price or specification not in line with commercial norms
indicators.desc: Equipment priced far above or below market, or specifications altered to fall below control thresholds.
indicators.ctx: Equipment priced far above or below market, or specifications altered to fall below control thresholds.
indicators.fp: Prices vary with customisation and volume.

indicators.name: Orders for items matching procurement watch lists or inquiries
indicators.canon: Orders for items matching procurement watch lists or inquiries
indicators.desc: Goods, parties or addresses match published alerts by export-control or enforcement authorities.
indicators.ctx: Goods, parties or addresses match published alerts by export-control or enforcement authorities.
indicators.fp: List data may be dated or generic.

indicators.name: Use of multiple intermediaries or repeated changes of consignee
indicators.canon: Repeated change of consignee or buyer in transit
indicators.desc: Shipments or cargoes are re-routed, re-invoiced or have ownership shifted through successive parties without clear commercial reason.
indicators.ctx: Shipments are re-routed or re-invoiced through successive parties.
